steps.content: The battle rages without end. Monsters surge from every branching tunnel, wave after wave, their howls echoing as they lunge forward.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...There are too many of them...!
The air churns with Mania—that sickening, familiar sensation that coils in Horo's gut.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Don't tell me this is...!
A cold dread shoots up her spine. A terrible suspicion flares in her mind, one she doesn't want to believe, yet can't ignore. She has to confirm it.

Gritting her teeth, she channels every shred of strength into her arms and brings her blade down in a brutal arc. Foul blood sprays, shattered flesh flies, and there, amidst the carnage, she glimpses the source of the Mania. It is—

Before she can get a closer look, a blade buries itself into the ground beside her, missing her by inches. Her breath catches. No alchemic beast wields weapons like this. Someone is hiding in the horde, hunting her.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Who's there?!
The beast tide writhes in chaos, making it impossible to track the attacker. Strikes come from nowhere, each one carving fresh wounds into the Legion's members.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****! Are these mutts sniffing us out or something? Why do they keep multiplying?!
Nearby, Hella barely deflects a lunge from a small alchemic beast. She stumbles back, colliding against Horo's back.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Horo! What do we do now?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: No matter what, don't stop fighting!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: These monsters have <color=#fb9259>Underground marks</color>! The inheritance, Aurum Secretum's breakthrough development, and those "Aurum Secretum Warriors" meant to replace Sinners—

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Damn it, they're trying to create a Black Ring?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?! **** them, but—
—Who could be the Corpseborne?!
The image of a blonde figure flashes through Hella's mind.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No freaking way—?!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella! Where's the communicator Campbell gave you?!
Hella's hands scramble frantically through her clothes, taking out the special communicator, but all that answers her is the relentless buzz of a busy signal.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Dammit, it's useless! Can't get a single bar. Gotta be a jammer screwing with us! No signals in or out!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Ahhh!

In that split second of distraction, a snarling beast erupts from the shadows. The force of its lunge slams into her, sending her staggering backward. Losing her balance, she crashes straight into a seething pack of monsters.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...?! Quick, give me your hand!

Through the writhing mass of claws and teeth, Hella catches a glimpse of Horo's outstretched hand. Fighting through searing pain, she stretches her arm toward Horo—almost there, just a little farther—
Clang! Another strike cleaves the air. Hella's body jerks, her movement stuttering for half a heartbeat.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella—?!
The horde surges forward in a frenzied tide, ripping them apart. Darkness swallows them whole, dragging each into its own twisting, suffocating path.
